definitions.explanation: The act of throwing something. Used for throwing in general, pitching in baseball, and as a component in compound words.
A technique in judo, sumo, or other martial arts where the opponent is thrown to the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピッチャー→ピッチャー：09482_picchaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投|な}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{冴|さ}えて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{遠投|えんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投|な}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧で、⟦ランナー→ランナー：09483_rannaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦アウト→アウト：00007_auto⟧にした。
examples.english: The long throw was accurate, and the runner was called out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投|な}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{投|な}げ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: He scored an ippon with a brilliant throw.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{決|き}まり{手|て}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{投|な}げ{技|わざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{迫力|はくりょく}→迫力：14310_hakuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Among sumo winning techniques, throwing moves are the most impressive.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {投|な}げる (to throw). Functions both independently and as a component in many compound words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投|な}げ{技|わざ}: throwing technique (martial arts)
- {遠投|えんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投|な}げ: a long throw
- {投|な}げ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧: to win by throw

COMPOUNDS:
- {投|な}げ{売|う}り: selling at a loss, dumping
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}: tossing coins (as tips or offerings)
- {投|な}げ{出|だ}す: to throw out; to abandon
- {投|な}げ{縄|なわ}: lasso

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投球|とうきゅう}→投球：15510_toukyuu⟧: pitch (baseball) — more specific to baseball pitching
- {投擲|とうてき}: throwing (athletics) — formal term for track-and-field throwing events
